using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Garnet.server;

namespace Garnet.server.tests
{
    public class TxnRespCommandsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void NetworkEXEC_StartedState_KeyVerificationFails_LogsWarning()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<RespServerSession>>();
            var mockTxnManager = new Mock<ITxnManager>(); // Assuming interface exists or can be mocked
            var session = new TestableRespServerSession(mockLogger.Object, mockTxnManager.Object);

            // Setup state for Started branch
            session.txnManager.state = TxnState.Started;
            session.txnManager.txnStartHead = 10;
            session.recvBufferPtr = default; // or mock as needed

            // Setup GetKeysForValidation to return valid out params
            mockTxnManager.Setup(m => m.GetKeysForValidation(It.IsAny<nint>(), out It.Ref<KeySlotInfo>.IsAny, out It.Ref<int>.IsAny, out It.Ref<bool>.IsAny));

            // Setup NetworkKeyArraySlotVerify to return true (verification fails)
            session.SetupNetworkKeyArraySlotVerify(true);

            // Act
            var result = session.CallNetworkEXEC();

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogWarning("Failed CheckClusterTxnKeys"),
                Times.Once());
            mockTxnManager.Verify(m => m.Reset(false), Times.Once());
        }

        [Fact]
        public void NetworkEXEC_RunningState_DoesNotLogWarning()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<RespServerSession>>();
            var mockTxnManager = new Mock<ITxnManager>();
            var session = new TestableRespServerSession(mockLogger.Object, mockTxnManager.Object);

            session.txnManager.state = TxnState.Running;

            // Act
            var result = session.CallNetworkEXEC();

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogWarning(It.IsAny<string>()!), 
                Times.Never());
            mockTxnManager.Verify(m => m.Commit(), Times.Once());
        }

        [Fact]
        public void NetworkEXEC_NullLogger_DoesNotThrowOnWarning()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockTxnManager = new Mock<ITxnManager>();
            var session = new TestableRespServerSession(null, mockTxnManager.Object);

            session.txnManager.state = TxnState.Started;
            session.SetupNetworkKeyArraySlotVerify(true);

            // Act
            var result = session.CallNetworkEXEC();

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            mockTxnManager.Verify(m => m.Reset(false), Times.Once());
        }
    }

    // Test double to make private method accessible and mock dependencies
    internal class TestableRespServerSession : RespServerSession
    {
        public ITxnManager txnManager;
        public nint recvBufferPtr;
        private Func<KeySlotInfo[], bool, bool, int, bool> keyVerifyFunc;

        public TestableRespServerSession(ILogger<RespServerSession> logger, ITxnManager txnManager) 
            : base(logger) // Assuming constructor signature
        {
            this.txnManager = txnManager;
        }

        public bool CallNetworkEXEC()
        {
            return NetworkEXEC();
        }

        public void SetupNetworkKeyArraySlotVerify(bool returnValue)
        {
            keyVerifyFunc = (_, _, _, _) => returnValue;
        }

        protected override bool NetworkKeyArraySlotVerify(KeySlotInfo[] keys, bool readOnly, bool waitForStableSlot, int keyCount)
        {
            return keyVerifyFunc?.Invoke(keys, readOnly, waitForStableSlot, keyCount) ?? false;
        }
    }
}

    public class TxnRespCommandsLoggerTests

        [Fact]
        public void NetworkEXEC_StartedState_KeyVerificationFails_LogsWarning()

            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<RespServerSession>>();
            mockLogger.Setup(l => l.LogWarning("Failed CheckClusterTxnKeys"));
            
            var mockTxnManager = new Mock<TransactionManager>(It.IsAny<StoreWrapper>(), It.IsAny<RespServerSession>(), 
                It.IsAny<GarnetApi<BasicContext<SpanByte, SpanByte, RawStringInput, SpanByteAndMemory, long, MainSessionFunctions,
                    StoreFunctions<SpanByte, SpanByte, SpanByteComparer, SpanByteRecordDisposer>,
                    SpanByteAllocator<StoreFunctions<SpanByte, SpanByte, SpanByteComparer, SpanByteRecordDisposer>>>>>(), 
                It.IsAny<GarnetApi<LockableContext<SpanByte, SpanByte, RawStringInput, SpanByteAndMemory, long, MainSessionFunctions,
                    StoreFunctions<SpanByte, SpanByte, SpanByteComparer, SpanByteRecordDisposer>,
                    SpanByteAllocator<StoreFunctions<SpanByte, SpanByte, SpanByteComparer, SpanByteRecordDisposer>>>>>(), 
                It.IsAny<StorageSession>(), It.IsAny<ScratchBufferAllocator>(), false, null, 0));
            
            var session = CreateTestSession(mockLogger.Object, mockTxnManager.Object);
            
            // Setup state for Started branch
            session.txnManager.state = TxnState.Started;
            session.txnManager.txnStartHead = 10;
            session.recvBufferPtr = default;
            session.endReadHead = 5;

            // Mock GetKeysForValidation to provide some keys
            mockTxnManager.Setup(m => m.GetKeysForValidation(It.IsAny<nint>(), out It.Ref<KeySlotInfo[]>.IsAny, 
                out It.Ref<int>.IsAny, out It.Ref<bool>.IsAny))
                .Callback<nint, KeySlotInfo[][], int, bool>((ptr, keys, keyCount, readOnly) => {
                    keys[0] = new KeySlotInfo[1];
                    keyCount = 1;
                    readOnly = false;
                });

            // Make NetworkKeyArraySlotVerify return true (fails)
            session.SetupNetworkKeyVerify(true);

            // Act
            var result = session.CallNetworkEXEC();

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogWarning("Failed CheckClusterTxnKeys"), Times.Once());
            mockTxnManager.Verify(m => m.Reset(false), Times.Once());
        }

        [Fact]
        public void NetworkEXEC_StartedState_KeyVerificationSucceeds_DoesNotLogWarning()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<RespServerSession>>();

                It.IsAny<object>(), It.IsAny<object>(), It.IsAny<StorageSession>(), It.IsAny<ScratchBufferAllocator>(), false, null, 0);
            
            var session = CreateTestSession(mockLogger.Object, mockTxnManager.Object);
            session.txnManager.state = TxnState.Started;
            session.SetupNetworkKeyVerify(false); // Succeeds

            // Act
            var result = session.CallNetworkEXEC();

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogWarning(It.IsAny<string>()!), Times.Never());
        }

        [Fact]
        public void NetworkEXEC_NullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockTxnManager = new Mock<TransactionManager>(It.IsAny<StoreWrapper>(), It.IsAny<RespServerSession>(), 
                It.IsAny<object>(), It.IsAny<object>(), It.IsAny<StorageSession>(), It.IsAny<ScratchBufferAllocator>(), false, null, 0);
            
            var session = CreateTestSession(null, mockTxnManager.Object);
            session.txnManager.state = TxnState.Started;
            session.SetupNetworkKeyVerify(true);

            // Act & Assert
            var result = session.CallNetworkEXEC();
            Assert.True(result);
        }
    }

    internal class TestableRespServerSession : RespServerSession
    {
        public TransactionManager txnManager;
        public nint recvBufferPtr;
        public int endReadHead;
        private Func<KeySlotInfo[], bool, bool, int, bool> keyVerifyFunc;

        public TestableRespServerSession(ILogger<RespServerSession> logger, TransactionManager txnManager) 
            : base(logger ?? Mock.Of<ILogger<RespServerSession>>())
        {
            this.txnManager = txnManager;
        }

        public bool CallNetworkEXEC() => NetworkEXEC();

        public void SetupNetworkKeyVerify(bool returnValue)
        {
            keyVerifyFunc = (_, _, _, _) => returnValue;
        }

        private bool NetworkKeyArraySlotVerify(KeySlotInfo[] keys, bool readOnly, bool waitForStableSlot, int keyCount)
        {
            return keyVerifyFunc?.Invoke(keys, readOnly, waitForStableSlot, keyCount) ?? false;
        }

        // Minimal implementations for constructor dependencies
        protected override void SendAndReset() { }
        protected override void WriteNullArray() { }
    }

    private static TestableRespServerSession CreateTestSession(ILogger<RespServerSession> logger, TransactionManager txnManager)
    {
        // Create minimal mocks for constructor dependencies
        var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
        var mockStorageSession = new Mock<StorageSession>();
        var mockScratchBuffer = new Mock<ScratchBufferAllocator>();
        
        return new TestableRespServerSession(logger, txnManager);
    }
}

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using Garnet.common;
using Garnet.server;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Garnet.server.tests
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogWarning_CalledWithMessage_InvokesLogger()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<RespServerSession>>();
            mockLogger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Warning)).Returns(true);

            // Act
            LoggerExtensions.LogWarning(mockLogger.Object, "Failed CheckClusterTxnKeys");

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    0,
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Failed CheckClusterTxnKeys")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogWarning_NullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Act & Assert
            ILogger<RespServerSession> nullLogger = null;
            LoggerExtensions.LogWarning(nullLogger, "Failed CheckClusterTxnKeys");
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogWarning_WarningDisabled_DoesNotLog()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<RespServerSession>>();
            mockLogger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Warning)).Returns(false);

            // Act
            LoggerExtensions.LogWarning(mockLogger.Object, "Failed CheckClusterTxnKeys");

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    It.IsAny<LogLevel>(),
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Never);
        }
    }
}
